data.name: Ruwaisha
data.gender_notes: Ruwaisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is gentle and compassionate. The name Ruwaisha carries the meaning “Gentleness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ruwaisha usually hope their child will grow to embody gentleness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Refers to a person who embodies the qualities of gentleness, compassion, and empathy towards others and herself
data.etymology: Ruwaisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentleness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruwaisha total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: رويشة
in_arabic.meaning: رويشة تعني الفتاة الجميلة التي تروي الناظرين بجمالها
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رويشة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-و-ش' والذي يدل على الاشراق والجمال. يعني الفتاة التي تروي عيون الناظرين بجمالها واشراقها، وتتميز بالحسن والبهاء. وقد ورد هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصف الجنة والخلق الحسن.

in_urdu.name: رویشہ
in_urdu.meaning: رویشہ کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت لڑکی جو اپنے دیکھنے والوں کو اپنی خوبصورتی سے سیراب کرتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رویشہ نام عربی جڑ 'ر-و-ش' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اشراق اور جمال. یہ نام خوبصورت اور سحر انگیز لڑکی کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو دیکھنے والوں کو اپنی خوبصورتی سے محظوظ کرتی ہے. یہ جڑ عربی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: रवैशा
in_hindi.meaning: रवैशा का अर्थ है सुंदर लड़की जो देखन वालों को अपनी सुंदरता से तृप्त करती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रवैशा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'र-व-श' से हुई है जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश और सौंदर्य. यह नाम सुंदर और आकर्षक लड़की के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो देखन वालों को अपनी सुंदरता से आनंदित करती है. अरबी भाषा और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका विशेष महत्व है.

in_pashto.name: رويشه
in_pashto.meaning: رويشه معنی يې دا ده چې هغه ښکلۍ نجلۍ چې د هغې ښکلا د کتونکو سترګې روي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د رويشه نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر-و-ش' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د روښانۍ او ښکلا معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د هغې ښکلي او جمیلې نجلۍ لپاره کارول کیږي چې د هغې ښکلا د کتونکو سترګې سيرابوي. په پښتو کلتور کې دا نوم د ارزښت وړ دی.

in_english.name: Ruwaisha
in_english.meaning: Ruwaisha means a beautiful girl who satisfies the onlookers with her beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ruwaisha is derived from the Arabic root 'ر-و-ش' (r-w-sh), which signifies radiance and beauty. It refers to a beautiful and charming girl whose presence delights and satisfies those who gaze upon her. This root is mentioned in the Quran in contexts describing paradise and good creation. The name carries spiritual significance, symbolizing inner and outer beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ruwaisha is deeply rooted in Arabic culture, with the meaning reflecting the values of compassion and gentleness. In an Islamic context, being compassionate and gentle towards others is a virtue highly emphasized, especially towards those who are vulnerable, such as orphans, the elderly, and the sick. The name Ruwaisha can be seen as a reminder of the importance of treating others with kindness and understanding.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Ruwaisha lies in its reflection of the qualities of God, particularly His mercy and compassion towards His creation. In Islamic teachings, it is believed that God is the most merciful and compassionate being, and He shows His mercy and compassion towards all His creation, regardless of their deeds. The name Ruwaisha can serve as a reminder to strive towards embodying the qualities of God, and to treat others with mercy and compassion, as He does.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Gentleness" symbolizes The one who is gentle and compassionate. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ruwaisha serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of gentleness.
